title: Saya Irie’s Intricate Sculptures Recomposed from Eraser...
content: Saya Irie’s Intricate Sculptures Recomposed from Eraser Shavings. “The Japanese artist erases images & then uses those eraser shavings to recompose the images into three-dimensional form, transforming the byproduct of erasure into delicate works of art.”
author: Jason Kottke
